mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer (id, data_set_id, source_file_id, layer_key, layer_name, group_id, original_group_id, geometry_type, assignment_mode, enabled, style_mode) VALUES (#{l.id}, #{l.dataSetId}, #{l.sourceFileId}, #{l.layerKey}, #{l.layerName}, #{l.groupId}, #{l.originalGroupId}, #{l.geometryType}, #{l.assignmentMode}, #{l.enabled}, #{l.styleMode})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer WHERE source_file_id = #{fileId} AND layer_status = 'IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l WHERE l.source_file_id = #{fileId} AND l.deleted = 0 ORDER BY l.id
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET layer_status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY'
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id = l.data_set_id AND ds.deleted = 0 WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.layer_status = 'READY' FOR UPDATE OF l
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l SET feature_count = s.total, geographic_extent = CASE WHEN s.total = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ST_SetSRID(s.bounds::geometry,4326) END, geometry_types = COALESCE(s.types, '[]'::jsonb), data_version = l.data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (SELECT count(*) AS total, ST_Extent(geom) AS bounds, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT GeometryType(geom) ORDER BY GeometryType(geom)) AS types FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature WHERE layer_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) s WHERE l.id = #{id} AND l.deleted = 0
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET deleted = 1, source_file_id = NULL, data_version = data_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature SET deleted = 1, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND id = #{id} AND version = #{expected} AND deleted = 0

mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_style SET is_default = false, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE layer_id = #{layerId} AND is_default
UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_style SET is_default = true, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND layer_id = #{layerId} AND version = #{expected}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style WHERE id = #{id} AND layer_id = #{layerId} AND version = #{expected} AND NOT is_default
mapper.select: SELECT set_config('statement_timeout', CAST(#{milliseconds} AS text), true) || set_config('jit','off',true)
SELECT FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_data_set ds ON ds.id=s.data_set_id AND ds.deleted=0 AND ds.category_id=2 WHERE s.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT g.*,count(l.id) AS layer_count,COALESCE(sum(l.feature_count),0)::bigint AS feature_count FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group g LEFT JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.group_id=g.id AND l.data_set_id=g.data_set_id AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' WHERE g.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} GROUP BY g.id ORDER BY g.sort_order,g.id
SELECT * FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_group WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_dataset_style SET data_revision=data_revision+CASE WHEN #{data} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, display_revision=display_revision+CASE WHEN #{display} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE data_set_id=#{dataSetId}

UPDATE ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer SET group_id=#{l.groupId},assignment_mode=#{l.assignmentMode}, enabled=#{l.enabled},style_mode=#{l.styleMode},presentation_version=presentation_version+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{l.id} AND presentation_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0 AND layer_status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.layer_id,s.name,s.is_default, CASE WHEN sum(octet_length(s.definition::text)) OVER() <= 1048576 THEN s.definition::text END AS definition_json,s.version FROM ocean_gis.gis_vector_style s JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_layer l ON l.id=s.layer_id WHERE l.data_set_id=#{dataSetId} AND l.deleted=0 AND l.layer_status='READY' AND l.enabled AND l.style_mode='CUSTOM' AND s.is_default AND l.id IN #{id}

WITH settings AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,ST_Buffer(view_box,resolution*64,'join=mitre') AS render_box FROM ( SELECT 40075016.68557849/(power(2.0,#{ctx.displayZoom})*256.0) AS resolution, CAST(#{policyJson} AS jsonb) AS policy, ST_Transform(
ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)
ST_Collect(ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},180,#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326), ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326))
,3857) AS view_box, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-85.0511287798066,180,85.0511287798066,4326) AS world_geo ) s ), plans AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p AS plan,(p->>'layerId')::bigint AS layer_id,(p->>'groupId')::bigint AS group_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{plansJson} AS jsonb)) p ), matched AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT f.id,f.layer_id,f.properties,f.geom,p.group_id,p.plan,r.rule FROM plans p JOIN ocean_gis.gis_vector_feature f ON f.layer_id=p.layer_id AND f.deleted=0 CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.value AS rule FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.plan->'rules') WITH ORDINALITY r(value,seq) WHERE ocean_gis.vector_filter_matches(f.properties,r.value->'filter',(p.plan->>'normalized')::boolean) AND (NOT (p.plan->>'zoomBeforeMatch')::boolean OR ((r.value->>'minZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (r.value->>'minZoom')::double precision) AND (r.value->>'maxZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} < (r.value->>'maxZoom')::double precision))) ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1 ) r WHERE
f.geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326) AND ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326))
(ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(#{ctx.bbox[0]},#{ctx.bbox[1]},180,#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)) OR ST_Intersects(f.geom,ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,#{ctx.bbox[1]},#{ctx.bbox[2]},#{ctx.bbox[3]},4326)))
AND COALESCE((r.rule->>'visible')::boolean,true) AND (r.rule->>'minZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (r.rule->>'minZoom')::double precision) AND (r.rule->>'maxZoom' IS NULL OR #{ctx.displayZoom} < (r.rule->>'maxZoom')::double precision)
), projected AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT m.*,s.resolution,s.policy,s.view_box,s.render_box, ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Transform(ST_Intersection(ST_Force2D(m.geom),s.world_geo),3857), CASE m.plan->>'kind' WHEN 'POINT' THEN 1 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS source_geom FROM matched m CROSS JOIN settings s ), visible AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Intersection(source_geom,view_box), CASE plan->>'kind' WHEN 'POINT' THEN 1 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END) AS view_geom FROM projected ), candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,plan->>'kind'='POINT' OR (plan->>'kind'='POLYGON' AND (plan->>'pixelExempt')::boolean) AS is_protected, COALESCE((rule->>'minZoom')::double precision,0) AS priority, CASE plan->>'kind' WHEN 'LINE' THEN ST_Length(view_geom)/resolution WHEN 'POLYGON' THEN sqrt(ST_Area(view_geom))/resolution ELSE 0 END AS pixel_size FROM visible WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(view_geom) AND (plan->>'kind'!='POLYGON' OR (plan->>'pixelExempt')::boolean OR ST_Area(view_geom)/(resolution*resolution) >= (policy->'pixelFilters'->>'polygonMinAreaPixels')::double precision) AND (plan->>'kind'!='LINE' OR ST_Length(view_geom)/resolution >= (policy->'pixelFilters'->>'lineMinProjectedLengthPixels')::double precision) )
mapper.select: , stats AS ( SELECT count(*) AS candidate_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_protected) AS protected_count FROM candidates ), buckets AS ( SELECT priority,pixel_size,count(*) AS n FROM candidates WHERE NOT is_protected GROUP BY priority,pixel_size ), ranked AS ( SELECT *,sum(n) OVER(ORDER BY priority,pixel_size DESC) AS cumulative FROM buckets ), cutoff AS ( SELECT r.* FROM ranked r CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE r.cumulative > greatest(#{ctx.budget}-s.protected_count,0) ORDER BY r.priority,r.pixel_size DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT s.candidate_count, CASE WHEN c.priority IS NULL THEN s.candidate_count ELSE s.protected_count+c.cumulative-c.n END::bigint AS object_count, c.priority AS cutoff_min_zoom,c.pixel_size AS cutoff_pixel_size FROM stats s LEFT JOIN cutoff c ON true

, selected AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE is_protected OR CAST(#{ctx.cutoffMinZoom,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AS double precision) IS NULL OR priority < #{ctx.cutoffMinZoom,jdbcType=DOUBLE} OR (priority=#{ctx.cutoffMinZoom,jdbcType=DOUBLE} AND pixel_size > #{ctx.cutoffPixelSize,jdbcType=DOUBLE}) ), shapes AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,CASE WHEN plan->>'kind'='POINT' THEN view_geom ELSE ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(source_geom,resolution*(policy->'generalization'->>'maxErrorPixels')::double precision) END AS simplified_geom, ST_PointOnSurface(source_geom) AS anchor, CASE WHEN (plan->'labels'->>'enabled')::boolean AND #{ctx.displayZoom} >= (plan->'labels'->>'minZoom')::double precision THEN nullif(left(COALESCE(properties->>(plan->'labels'->>'field'),properties->>(plan->'labels'->>'fallbackField')),200),'') END AS label FROM selected ), labels AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT *,row_number() OVER(ORDER BY (plan->>'renderOrder')::integer,id) AS label_rank FROM shapes WHERE label IS NOT NULL AND ST_Intersects(anchor,view_box) ), representations AS ( SELECT s.id,s.layer_id,s.group_id,s.rule,s.plan, CASE WHEN s.plan->>'kind'='POLYGON' THEN 'FILL' ELSE 'GEOMETRY' END AS role, s.plan->>'kind' AS category,s.rule->'symbol' AS symbol,NULL::text AS label, ST_Intersection(s.simplified_geom,s.render_box) AS display_geom FROM shapes s UNION ALL SELECT s.id,s.layer_id,s.group_id,s.rule,s.plan,'OUTLINE','LINE', jsonb_build_object('color',s.rule->'symbol'->>'strokeColor','width',s.rule->'symbol'->'strokeWidth', 'opacity',s.rule->'symbol'->'strokeOpacity'),NULL, ST_Intersection(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(ST_Boundary(s.source_geom), s.resolution*(s.policy->'generalization'->>'maxErrorPixels')::double precision),s.render_box) FROM shapes s WHERE s.plan->>'kind'='POLYGON' AND COALESCE((s.rule->'symbol'->>'strokeWidth')::double precision,0)>0 UNION ALL SELECT l.id,l.layer_id,l.group_id,l.rule,l.plan,'LABEL','POINT',l.rule->'symbol',l.label,l.anchor FROM labels l WHERE l.label_rank <= ceil((#{ctx.widthPixels}::double precision*#{ctx.heightPixels})/ (l.policy->'labels'->>'pixelsPerLabel')::double precision) AND least(power(2,#{z})-1,greatest(0,floor((ST_X(l.anchor)+20037508.342789244)/40075016.68557849*power(2,#{z}))))=#{x} AND least(power(2,#{z})-1,greatest(0,floor((20037508.342789244-ST_Y(l.anchor))/40075016.68557849*power(2,#{z}))))=#{y} ), encoded AS ( SELECT o.id::text || ':' || o.role AS "_vector_representation_id",o.role AS "_vector_render_role", o.id::text AS "_vector_feature_id",o.layer_id::text AS "_vector_layer_id",o.group_id::text AS "_vector_group_id", o.rule->>'id' AS "_vector_rule_id",o.symbol::text AS "_vector_symbol", o.category AS "_vector_category",1::bigint AS "_vector_feature_count",o.label AS "_vector_label", (o.plan->>'renderOrder')::integer AS "_vector_render_order",g.geom FROM representations o CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(o.display_geom,ST_TileEnvelope(#{z},#{x},#{y}),4096,1024,true) AS geom OFFSET 0 ) g WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(g.geom) AND ST_Dimension(g.geom)=CASE o.category WHEN 'POINT' THEN 0 WHEN 'LINE' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ), tile AS ( SELECT COALESCE(ST_AsMVT(encoded,'features',4096,'geom'),''::bytea) AS body FROM encoded ) SELECT CASE WHEN octet_length(body) <= #{maxBytes} THEN body END AS body,octet_length(body)::bigint AS byte_size FROM tile
